payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is there image-grounded evidence of any relevant progress toward rendering the content as a pencil drawing, even if the overall transformation is incomplete?
node.criteria: Pass if visible changes move the image toward a pencil-drawn rendering, including partial stylization; fail if sufficient evidence shows no requested transformation has progressed; unknown if evidence is insufficient. Muted color, grain, or softened edges may support progress but do not establish completion. Unrelated edits do not count.
node.binding: Assess only visible changes in the supplied image relative to the source that move its visual content toward a pencil-drawn style. Do not decide completion or infer progress from unrelated changes.
